evals.name: init-3layer-task
evals.prompt: We need to automate the generation of a weekly summary report from our database. Use the 3-layer architecture to set this up: create a directive detailing the SOP and an execution script to fetch and format the data.
evals.expected_output: Directive created in directives/ and Python script created in execution/.

assertions.text: Directive includes Goal, Inputs, and Tools sections

evals.name: repair-and-anneal
evals.prompt: The script 'execution/process_orders.py' is crashing due to a missing 'status' field in some JSON records. Fix the script to handle missing fields and then update 'directives/order_processing.md' to include this edge case validation.
evals.expected_output: Script handles errors; Directive documented the edge case.

assertions.text: Execution script handles the missing field case
Directive mentions the 'status' field edge case
